message.content:
The red border is 0.5 inches wide on every side of the picture.

Picture dimensions: \(5 \times 7 = 35\) square inches.

The outer red paper dimensions increase by \(0.5\) inch on each side:

\[
5 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 6
\]
\[
7 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 8
\]

Area of outer red paper:

\[
6 \times 8 = 48
\]

Visible red border area:

\[
48 - 35 = 13
\]

The answer is 13 square inches.
